notes: Final output from browser-based resolution of boulder_unresolved.json. All 64 complexes processed. Search engine used: DuckDuckGo throughout (no CAPTCHA encountered; Bing was tried once as a fallback and returned real results too, but DDG was reused for consistency for the rest of the run). Buildings A/D/F/G (Spine Rd) inferred as the same 'Apex 5510' complex based on shared street and lettering convention -- only Building D's address was independently confirmed via search, so A/F/G carry moderate confidence. Boulder Housing Partners and Boardwalk Realty recur as operators across several properties (public/affordable housing and a local property-management portfolio, respectively) -- these were recorded as 'operator' rather than 'own_domain' since they host many properties on one domain rather than each property having its own site.
